title: The merge tool reads main's ruleset first, then the old branch protection
why:
Once the sweep moves a repo's main to a ruleset and removes the old protection, the merge tool, which reads only the old protection, would refuse every merge in that repo.

[19:19 CST Nov 15, triage] Since the owner removed all-jobs-passed as a required check (ruling own-all-jobs-passed-removed), the merge tool refuses every merge: "main has no branch protection and no ruleset that requires checks" (verbatim from runner 10's #3545 attempt at 19:18 CST). load_config (merge/merge.py:2533) reads stamp.json from origin/main; the pin PR #3564 (Pin merge.requiredChecks to all-jobs-passed; head 35c6d750f3, draft, only .github/stamp.json, a stale test being re-pointed) cannot land through the tool; the consultant asked the owner at 19:19 CST to merge #3564 himself in the GitHub web page once its run is green. Effect: no merge lands, page PRs included, until #3564 is on main. Debt draft merge-tool-needs-protection-or-pin in roadmap/outbox/triage.md; step merge-pin-required-checks. (source: coordinator 19:20 CST, relaying runner 10's refusal text (read by the coordinator, not triage); relayed by triage; not owner-typed)
source: Owner 19:49 CST Nov 11, page item 519 pick c ("c is prob best"), relayed by the retrospective; plan restart-plan 1cce54a, R45 Rulesets paragraph
